summary: Triangular sprites emit maroon projectiles that travel along axis-aligned or diagonal paths, colliding to produce blue or recoloring opposing sprites to maroon.
path: L-shaped sprites emit along diagonal from apex; V-shaped sprites emit along axis from apex; collision at 5 cells from apex
transform: if projectile hits opposing sprite, recolor entire sprite to maroon; if two projectiles collide, paint blue at intersection
multi_step: Step 1: identify sprite orientation (axis-aligned vs diagonal) by checking pixel arrangement; Step 2: determine emission direction from apex; Step 3: cast ray from position 4 cells beyond apex; Step 4: on collision with another projectile path paint blue, on collision with opposing sprite recolor sprite to maroon
